description_en: Reapplies for a free certificate for a SaaS domain name. This operation is supported only when the current free certificate application fails, is about to expire, or has expired
description_zh: 重新申请 SaaS 域名的免费证书，仅支持当前免费证书申请失败、即将过期、已过期时调用
name: ApplyCustomHostnameCertificate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SaaS domain name. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html operation
parameters.help_zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html接口获取
parameters.name: hostname_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
